sense: bring young out of the egg

evidence: Cic. ND 2.129: gallīnae avēsque reliquae, cum ex ōvīs pullōs exclūserint (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Literally to shut out: the bird drives the chick out of the egg. The eggs or the young are the object.

phrases.latin: gallīnae avēsque reliquae, cum ex ōvīs pullōs exclūserint
phrases.english: hens and the other birds, when they have hatched their chicks from the eggs
